mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (project_id, title, description, status, priority, assignee, creator_id, handler_id, due_date) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{assignee}, #{creatorId}, #{handlerId}, #{dueDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, assignee = #{assignee}, creator_id = #{creatorId}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
